t: 英军在克罗托伊战役中击败了一支旨在给被围困的加来人带来救济的法国分舰队.
te: The English defeat a French fleet which aimed to bring relief to the besieged Calais in the battle of Crotoy.
dz: 英军在克罗托伊战役中击败了一支旨在给被围困的加来人带来救济的法国分舰队.
de: The English defeat a French fleet which aimed to bring relief to the besieged Calais in the battle of Crotoy.

t: 皇帝查理四世协助为布拉格的查尔斯桥奠基.
te: Emperor Charles IV assists in laying the foundation stone of Charles Bridge in Prague.
dz: 皇帝查理四世协助为布拉格的查尔斯桥奠基.
de: Emperor Charles IV assists in laying the foundation stone of Charles Bridge in Prague.
